Mature Suburban & Historic Tree Canopies · Princeton, NJ

Why Princeton Homes Face Unique Gutter Challenges

Princeton is defined by its mature tree canopy — the century-old oaks, silver maples, and sycamores that line every street in Mercer County. That canopy is beautiful, but it drops an enormous volume of leaves, samaras (maple helicopters), and seed pods onto the roofline three seasons a year.

Un-guarded gutters in Princeton, NJ fill in a single storm. Once water overflows the trough, it runs behind the fascia and down the exterior wall — the exact failure mode that rots rafter tails, stains brick, and floods finished basements. Homes with slate or cedar detailing lose even more when a low-quality guard is bolted onto the shingle.

Our fix is a high-flow LeafBlaster Pro micro-mesh system, mounted low-profile so it disappears behind the drip edge on historic Princeton homes. The mesh moves 100+ inches of hourly rainfall while the marine-grade stainless keeps every oak leaf, samara, and pine tassel out of the trough for the life of the roof.

High-flow micro-mesh

Engineered to move 100+ inches of hourly rainfall — the volume Princeton thunderstorms actually drop on a mature roof.

Permanent Outdoor Lighting FAQ

Everything Princeton homeowners ask us

How much do permanent LED lights cost in Princeton?

Most Princeton homes run $3,500–$8,500 installed depending on roofline complexity and linear footage. We give a firm on-site quote after measuring — no ballpark surprises.

Can I still use them for holidays besides Christmas?

Yes. Every color, every pattern, every holiday. Red-white-blue for the Fourth of July, orange for Halloween, green for St. Patrick's Day, team colors for game day, and a warm-white 'downlight' look for every other night.

Are the lights visible during the day?

The color-matched aluminum channel is nearly invisible from the street. Most neighbors don't notice the system until the first time it turns on.

Do they work in NJ winters?

Yes. The RGBW LEDs and channel are engineered for outdoor use in freezing temperatures, ice, and heavy rain. All splices are weatherproof.

Is there a warranty?

The LED modules carry a multi-year manufacturer warranty, and our workmanship is warranted for life. If a section ever goes dark, we come back and fix it.

Why do standard gutter screens fail against Princeton's tree canopy?

Massive volume clogs cause water to overflow behind the fascia, rotting rafter tails, staining brick, and flooding basements at the drip line. In Princeton, NJ, that is exactly why we install LeafBlaster Pro 316 stainless micro-mesh instead of a slotted screen or foam insert.

How do freeze-thaw cycles and winter weather in Mercer County affect micro-mesh guards?

Mercer County sees repeated freeze-thaw cycles from December through March. Rigid 316 stainless micro-mesh, mounted on a powder-coated aluminum sub-frame, does not warp, sag, or crack under ice load — the reason we install LeafBlaster Pro exclusively on Princeton homes rather than pop-in plastic or foam inserts.

Do you provide same-day estimates and installation in Princeton, NJ?
